news.summary: Authorities say the fire in September is part of a broader campaign against European countries that support Ukraine.

news.title: Opposition leader María Machado returns from exile to a Venezuela reshaped by Trump
news.summary: Machado returns with Trump's blessing, even if Washington is happy with Venezuela's existing leader - at least for the time being.

news.summary: Espanhola conquistou 4 títulos pelo Barcelona na temporada e foi eleita a melhor jogadora da Champions League; premiação é organizada pela revista francesa "France Football"

news.title: Iran war live: Iran says US ‘not serious’ about talks; ship ablaze off Iraq
news.summary: Iran says the United States is "not serious" about negotiations as UKMTO reports a ship on fire off the coast of Iraq.

news.title: El Ejército de Israel afirma haber matado a dos miembros de Hamás y dos de Yihad Islámica en bombardeos contra Gaza
news.summary: El Ejército de Israel ha afirmado este lunes haber matado a "cuatro terroristas" que ha vinculado a partes iguales al Movimiento de Resistencia Islámica (Hamás) y a Yihad Islámica, todo ello en varios bombardeos ejecutados durante el fin de semana en "norte, centro y sur de la Franja de Gaza", a pesar del alto el fuego.

news.title: Flavio Bolsonaro vows to lead opposition after Brazil court imposes travel ban
news.summary: Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro said on Monday a Supreme Court justice had barred him from leaving the country after he narrowly lost to incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. Bolsonaro, who refused to concede defeat, denounced the order as intimidation and vowed to challenge the election results.

news.title: PL reconhece vitória de Lula após Flávio contestar resultado
news.summary: Partido de Valdemar Costa Neto aceita resultado das urnas, mas questiona gastos do governo na reta final das eleições

news.title: PL reconhece derrota para Lula nas eleições, mas quer esclarecimentos
news.summary: Em nota, partido do candidato derrotado Flávio Bolsonaro disse que seguirá "acompanhando os fatos e buscando respostas com responsabilidade, transparência e respeito às instituições".

news.title: Bolsonaro says police demand passports after Brazil election defeat
news.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro posted a video on social media saying police ordered him to surrender his passports

news.title: Erika Hilton aciona PF para investigar casos de violência nas eleições
news.summary: Deputada associa escalada das ocorrências à postura de Flávio Bolsonaro diante do resultado eleitoral

news.title: Jordan strikes Syria after church attack, killing at least seven people
news.summary: Syria closes border crossings with Jordan after air strikes kill seven people in Deraa and Suweyda, including children.

news.title: Jordan attacks Syria in response to Karak church attack
news.summary: Jordan’s air force has carried out several strikes in southern Syria in response to Friday’s church attack.

news.title: Harry Kane ends England's 25-year Ballon d'Or drought, Putellas wins third crown
news.summary: Harry Kane became the first Englishman in 25 years to win the Ballon d’Or on Monday after scoring 73 goals for club and country last season. Spain’s Alexia Putellas claimed her third women’s award after helping Barcelona win the Champions League, ending teammate Aitana Bonmati’s three-year reign.

news.title: Europe's top NATO powers pledge greater defence role, reaffirm US alliance
news.summary: Europe's five main NATO members said on Monday they were ready to take greater responsibility for the continent's security while reaffirming the United States as an "indispensable ally". Defence ministers from France, Germany, Italy, Poland and Britain pledged closer co-operation with Washington after talks in Paris on strengthening Europe's defence role.

news.title: Risco país sobe ao maior nível desde março de 2026
news.summary: Indicador avançou depois da vitória de Lula; dólar, bolsa e juros futuros também registraram forte reação

news.title: Mecca pact nations hold talks with Iran to prevent renewed Middle East war
news.summary: Senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held talks in Iran on Monday aimed at preventing renewed fighting in the Middle East, with Tehran describing discussions as “very good”. The diplomatic push, attended by Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, followed warnings from Washington, Tehran and Israel of renewed hostilities.

news.title: Mass brawl between Galatasaray and Fenerbahce after Istanbul derby
news.summary: A mass brawl erupted between players of the Turkish football teams Galatasaray and Fenerbahce.

news.title: Flávio altera caminho para buscar reversão da derrota eleitoral
news.summary: Senador primeiro disse que queria anulação do segundo turno, mas depois anunciou intenção de pedir ao TSE a cassação da chapa de Lula, que venceu o pleito com 51,79% dos votos.

news.title: Flávio muda a rota e agora diz que vai pedir ao TSE cassação da chapa Lula-Alckmin
news.summary: Especialistas dizem que o argumento da anulação do pleito se tornou frágil e, por isso, o senador poderia ter corrigido a rota.

news.title: Netanyahu faces Israeli voters in first election since Oct. 7 and Gaza war
news.summary: Israelis will go to the polls on Tuesday in what many describe as the most consequential election in years. It's the first vote since the Oct. 7 Hamas attack and Israel's war in Gaza. Prime Minister Netanyahu has been campaigning that he'll keep Israel safe. But the opposition says Netanyahu failed to prevent the 2023 attack and is blocking an investigation into it. Nick Schifrin reports.

news.title: Lula prevails in Brazil but Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
news.summary: In a closely watched election, Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated right-wing and Trump-aligned challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. Transport and weather disruptions in parts of Brazil led to a chaotic final stretch at the polls. Bolsonaro is refusing to concede, and President Trump called the outcome "rigged." Stephanie Sy reports.

news.title: Trump critica eleições no Brasil, mas diz que gosta de Lula
news.summary: Sem apresentar provas, líder dos EUA disse que eleição no Brasil "pareceu fraudada". Casa Branca favorecia candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro, mas Trump destaca que "se dá bem com Lula".

news.title: Student-led movement ousts Serbia's right-wing ruler in historic election
news.summary: Brazil is not the only country to have had dramatic election results this weekend. In Serbia, longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic lost a historic election that brought down his government. William Brangham discussed the results with Heather Conley.

news.title: Entenda o que está em jogo nas eleições em Israel
news.summary: País vai às urnas pela primeira vez desde os ataques sofridos em 7 de outubro de 2023 e as investidas militares na Faixa de Gaza. Futuro de Netanyahu e novas respostas do exército israelense também estão em jogo.

news.title: Protests in Europe: Fact-checking viral videos amid claims of 'chaos'
news.summary: As young people protest poor school conditions and the rising cost of living across Europe, misleading videos are spreading online. Footage from Poland in 2017, military preparations in Portugal and a protest in Argentina have all been falsely presented as recent demonstrations in Europe, painting a misleading picture of unrest. Vedika Bahl fact-checks three viral videos to uncover what they really show and how old footage is recycled to spread misinformation and attract clicks.

news.title: Former FBI director James Comey hit with third set of charges under Trump
news.summary: Comey, who was fired during Trump's first term, has been accused of unlawfully divulging national security information.

news.title: Anthropic's IPO filing shows soaring sales and steep losses
news.summary: AI giant Anthropic has publicly filed for an initial public offering (IPO) with US market regulators. The document offered a glimpse into the company's finances but also contained nearly 100 pages related to risks around investing in the company. The filing revealed that in the first half of 2026, its revenue soared to $16.3 billion while net loss widened to over $80 billion. Plus, London's iconic Oxford Street, one of Europe's busiest shopping areas, has been partially pedestrianised.

news.title: O que vai acontecer com dólar e juros após derrocada dos mercados financeiros com vitória de Lula
news.summary: Contenção da 'sangria' que levou o dólar acima de R$ 5,40 e a bolsa a ter negociação interrompida vai depender de sinalização do governo para ajuste das contas públicas, dizem analistas.

news.title: Flávio desiste de pedir anulação da vitória de Lula nas urnas
news.summary: Senador vai concentrar ações judiciais em possíveis abusos de poder político e econômico cometidos pela campanha petista

news.title: Centrão será peça-chave para contrapor oposição fortalecida no Congresso, dizem especialistas
news.summary: Lula deve enfrentar um Congresso mais hostil no próximo mandato, com o fortalecimento do PL. Segundo especialistas, acordos com o Centrão e possíveis divisões na oposição serão decisivos para aprovar propostas e garantir governabilidade
